title: Wizard Duel
note_pattern: D is a drums phrase (kick on pad 1, snare on pad 4), B a bass phrase (held notes). One letter per two-bar phrase, repeating.
tier_note: [first phrase, tier]: the cues get busier the longer the duel runs. Both wizards always play the same notes at the same time.

power.note: A phrase passes at pass_credit (the share of cues hit) and casts one spell. quality = clamp((precision - 0.4) / 0.6) where precision is the weighted share of cues (perfect 1, great 0.8, ok 0.55) minus stray_cost per stray press. power = lerp(min, max, quality) x (1 + streak_bonus x consecutive earlier casts, at most streak_cap) x bass_mult for bass phrases x (1 + tier_step x (tier - 1)). Power and health are kept in tenths.
